name: First Contact
description: The squad makes first contact with the alien forces. Xal'Thun's raiding party ambushes the advance party. Casualties mount until the player chooses to hold the line or fall back.

objectives.description: Hold the line against the alien ambush

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Motion sensors confirm multiple contacts. They're not waiting for us to make the first move.

dialogue.speaker: Reaper
dialogue.line: Line holds. Get the wounded back and push forward.

dialogue.speaker: Spectre
dialogue.line: Trapped element secured. Their commander left something behind—a data core.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Prime
dialogue.line: Xal'Thun is merely a herald. The real enemy is already inside the ring's foundation.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Data core extracted. I'm running a decrypt. If the lore dump is anything like the last one, we're in for a long read.
